about.text: Varenets, sometimes anglicised as stewler or simmeler, is a fermented milk product that is popular in Russia. Similar to ryazhenka, it is made by adding sour cream (smetana) to baked milk.

how.text: Varenets is made from long-heated milk soured with thermophilic streptococci only, so it tastes clean and lactic with a distinct cooked-milk note. Traditionally it was baked milk set with smetana.
